title: Fix frontend signup gating vs session-invalid routing and add production-safe debug logging

requirements.summary: Treat authenticated “no profile yet” as an expected state (route to ProfileSetup) and reserve SessionInvalidScreen for genuine auth/session failures.
acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated and the backend indicates the user has no profile yet, the app renders ProfileSetup instead of SessionInvalidScreen.
SessionInvalidScreen is shown only for genuine authentication/session failures (e.g., invalid/expired delegation), not for expected new-user states.
No infinite loading loop occurs between login, profile fetch, and ProfileSetup.

file_operations.description: Refine auth/session error classification by introducing a distinct detection for “missing signup/profile” errors (based on known backend error strings for new principals) so they are not treated as stale/invalid sessions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update RootComponent gating logic to: (1) show SessionInvalidScreen only when isAuthError(profileError) AND NOT a detected new-user/missing-profile error; (2) route authenticated callers with userProfile === null OR a detected missing-profile error into ProfileSetup; (3) keep existing loading gating to avoid loops (use isInitializing/profileLoading/isFetched consistently). Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance for Profile Setup gating (getCallerUserProfile returning null) to align behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add targeted, sanitized console logging for authentication and profile-fetch state to debug persistent signup issues in production.
acceptanceCriteria: When running the app and reproducing the signup flow, the browser console includes clear logs for: authentication state, profile fetch state, and any encountered error message.
The logs do not include secrets (e.g., URL secret parameters such as `caffeineAdminToken`) or personally identifying form inputs (name/email/mobile/password).

file_operations.description: Create a small debug utility that emits consistent console logs for the signup/profile flow and sanitizes error messages (e.g., strip/replace sensitive URL secret parameter names like caffeineAdminToken and avoid logging principals or any form-input values). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add signup/profile-flow console logging at key decision points (initialization, authenticated vs not, profile query loading/fetched, gating decisions, and any profileError message via sanitizer). Ensure logs are present in production builds and do not include secrets/PII. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add targeted logs (via the shared debug utility) around the current-user profile query lifecycle: actor availability, query start/success (null vs profile), and sanitized error. Avoid logging any user-entered fields and avoid logging principals. Use the authorization component’s recommended pattern for getCallerUserProfile query state to ensure logging matches isLoading/isFetched semantics. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add minimal, sanitized logs (via the shared debug utility) indicating whether an identity is present and whether an actor was created/refreshed. Do not log the caffeineAdminToken or any URL parameter values. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add minimal logs for loginStatus transitions and whether identity is present after initialization/login success, using the shared debug utility and avoiding principal strings or any secrets. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
